hook.name: NulifyFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a volatility-based fee in native ETH on every swap: buys are charged on the ETH input in beforeSwap, sells on the ETH output in afterSwap (exact-input only). The fee rate floats between a configurable base and maximum (both within 1–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, scaling up during volatile conditions to protect LPs.
